notes.title: 📣 Medievaly: Battle Simulator is NOW Released on Steam!
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="oJEo637MNyg;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]
🏰 [b]Medievaly: Battle Simulator is OUT NOW![/b] 🐔⚔️[/h3][p]Raise your banners and ready up your troops — [b]Medievaly: Battle Simulator[/b] has officially launched! Dive into a colorful, medieval-style battle simulator where strategy meets chaotic warfare. Build your army, destroy enemy castles, and [b]lead your troops to glory in vibrant battlefields[/b]!
[/p][h3]💥 [b]Castle-Slaying Strategy, Real-Time Chaos![/b][/h3][p][b]Dive into the campaign[/b] - Take command where you’ll deploy knights, archers, and siege machines to crush enemy strongholds. Every move counts. Think fast, build smart, and [b]watch your strategy unfold in gloriously unpredictable battles[/b].
[/p][h3]🧱 [b]Three Game Modes, Infinite Fun![/b][/h3][p]• [b]Castle Siege[/b] – Tear down the enemy’s walls and win the war.
• [b]Time Survival[/b] – Outlast waves of enemies ‘til help arrives.
• [b]Kill Count[/b] – First to 100 kills earns eternal glory.
[/p][p]Craft your own war stories in [b]Sandbox Mode[/b], with custom rules and terrains!
[/p][h3]🔔 [b]Join the Kingdom![/b][/h3][p]We’re beyond excited to finally launch, and we’d love for you to be part of our growing community:
[/p][p]💬[url="https://discord.com/invite/d8WUuuRCJK"] Join our Discord[/url] to chat, share battle replays, and help shape the future of the game.
🐦 [url="https://twitter.com/Steelkrill"]Follow us on Twitter [/url]for updates, memes, and sneak peeks at what’s next.
⭐ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472300/Medievaly_Battle_Simulator/"]Leave a honest review on Steam[/url] - your honest feedback means [i]everything[/i] to us in order to improve
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472300/Medievaly_Battle_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][b]See you on the battlefield, commanders![/b]
- Steelkrill Studio[/p]
